notes.title: 1.0.15 Update - Stability improvements and more
notes.content:
[h1]1.0.15[/h1]
Major balancing and saved game
Following the release we got a lot of feedback from you. We worked as hard and as fast as we could.
Some of you are experiencing bugs ; this patch is the first of a series to fix all remaining issues. We already have identified issues we aren’t able to fix and ship today, but we don’t want to delay what we already fixed. So, if you still experience issues with this new release, please be patient, we’re on it!
As for gameplay, we adjusted the amount of fights per floor. To accommodate these new changes, we didn't have any choice but to erase any pre-existing saved game.

[h1]SMALL UPDATE / PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the amount of fights over each floors
[*] Increased heroes max HP by 5
[*] Decreased They Who Forbid HP to 225 from 300

[*] Fixed an issue with a scavenge option allowing to upgrade a Base attack without having Base attacks in deck
[*] Fixed various damage sources on hero leading to soft-lock
[*] Fixed an issue with Emissary of Kaïti expedition giving too much bonuses
[*] Fixed several memory leaks issues
[*] Fix various minor issues on Sohoma, Jokan and Sora 3D models
[/list]

[b]Additions / Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Lots of optimization to improve stability
[*] Added an icon to identify Card Removal nodes on the minimap
[*] Added two new foes to the first floor fights
[*] Korean translations corrections

notes.content:
[b][h3]A FULL NEW FACTION, FIXES AND ANIMATIONS![/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41497794/e5d460efd45cc4635dd645e8e3271c8a58eccee6.png[/img]

We worked as hard as we could to be ready for this special event. And we're proud of what we've done with the help of our community.

[b]New faction[/b]. It's the big news. The Tainted Ones joined the fray. New heroes, new cardpool, new unique powers. Explore a whole new experience beneath Oresa. No more Counter-attack to save you, but learn to harness the power of the Cobalt Curse to be the last fighter standing.

Also for those who wants to remain loyal to House Agiça de Ferady, new companion options! Because yes, you can pick up your companion among other factions. Which means that with every faction's release, the companions' pool increases and so do the possible builds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41497794/23cc3d66d19bc5d12a202ce81ecd2ba979130b84.png[/img]

[b]Animations[/b]. More animations and FX are on the way. And we won't stop until the game experience is more than gorgeous.

[b]Stability[/b]. Again: Huge thanks to the users who took the time to email us their crash logs. We solved a lot of stability issues and now that the Tainted Ones faction is released we'll have even more time to get to the bottom of the last remaining stability issues.

[b]Roadmap[/b]. And we won't stop here! We've got a lot of items on our list. The next faction is, obviously, a major milestone. Deep in our secret lab beneath Oresa, we're already working on it - and it may involve a lot of blasting and guns (adding a new flavor to our Zone system).

notes.title: WINTER SALE
notes.content:
[b][h3]A TON  OF FIXES, FEATURES, AND ANIMATIONS![/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41497794/e5d460efd45cc4635dd645e8e3271c8a58eccee6.png[/img]

In the past few weeks, we’ve worked hard on the game.

[b]Stability[/b] first, which improved greatly, and really, really: Huge thanks to the users who took the time to email us their crash logs. We can't thank you enough. The game is far more stable now, and we won't stop here - we’ve identified several possible improvements and are working on it.

[b]User features and balancing[/b]. It's nice to be a small studio with an active community. It helps to sort out what needs to be there next. We’ve added a lot of Quality of Life features, tooltips (we know, we still need more ^^), an option to check the game state during a choice, enhanced game over screen, and more.

[b]Animations[/b]. Every week, we’ve been able to improve the visuals of the game, new moves, new counter-attacks - and we're far from over! More animations and FX are on the way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41497794/8574072da30ccb6f9d0fee472b25e442fb46900b.png[/img]
[b]New game mode[/b]. The new Special Request game mode is here. As with the rest of the game, we will continue to iterate and improve upon it with every update.

[b]Roadmap[/b]. We’re still on track! The second faction is the next big thing. It should enter a closed test phase in January, and players can already see one of the new heroes in the new Special Request cards...

If you hesitated to step into the Agora and take on requests, now is the time. Beneath Oresa is getting better everyday - and the Winter Sale is just what you need to jump in!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41497794/e5d460efd45cc4635dd645e8e3271c8a58eccee6.png[/img]


We've got a lot to cover in this news alert so let's get started! 

Firstly we have a Road Map for Early Access that give you an idea of what is going to be available and what is going to be waiting until later on. 

Secondly, we want to make sure everything is perfect for Beneath Oresa at launch, and this means we've had to updated the release date slightly to [b]November 3rd[/b] . We would rather take the extra couple weeks and make sure you're getting the best experience right from the start!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41497794/15e07c969e9277a50003fc69425d7c6f1a581f01.png[/img]

At Early Access Launch you'll have: 

[list]
[*] Over 40 foes and 8 bosses are already roaming Oresa.
[*] The collections are complete. All cards and all antiquorums are available to uncover.
[*] Runs can be played to the end with all intended chapters, events, and bonuses.
[*] Choose your difficulty - be able to increase the challenge each run
[/list]

The game will be [b]Fully Playable[/b] from the start, with balancing updates coming frequently, and feedback taken from the community on [url=https://discord.gg/qx6zNEXvWR]Discord[/url] and implemented. 

Coming Soon are the additional features: 

[list]
[*] Lost Legion (faction) - New power, characters and cardset
[*] Guild of the Ruinfarers (faction) - New power, characters and cardset
[*] Dozens of special runs with unique rules
[*] All new arena effects such as toxic gas, or darkness, add new strategy to fights.
[*] New arenas throughout Oresa and an additional Final Boss option. 
[/list]

We are as much players as developers: for us, a game - even in Early Access - must keep the maximum of its promises.
We worked hard to make sure a full game experience is available at Early Access launch.

Yes, we have planned new characters, new card collections, new faction powers, 
but the game provides complete runs with all chapters and events. 

With the current faction you will already face all the enemies of the abandoned city, with all the encounters and unique objects to discover.

In other words: everything is already there to play the whole game and with your feedback and your support, we will continue to work at the forge to complete two additional factions and lots of other sweet features.

Thank you so much for the continued support of the community and we can't wait for you to explore Oresa! 

~The Broken Spear Team
